tasks.label: publish: macOS CLI
args: echo 'This task only runs on macOS.' 1>&2; exit 1

ARCH="$(uname -m)"; case "$ARCH" in arm64) RID=osx-arm64 ;; x86_64) RID=osx-x64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH" 1>&2; exit 1 ;; esac; dotnet publish '${workspaceFolder}/GTToolsSharp/GTToolsSharp.csproj' -c Release -r "$RID" --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:RollForward=LatestMajor -o "${workspaceFolder}/publish/$RID"

tasks.label: link: GTToolsSharp → ~/.local/bin
args: echo 'This task only runs on macOS.' 1>&2; exit 1

ARCH="$(uname -m)"; case "$ARCH" in arm64) RID=osx-arm64 ;; x86_64) RID=osx-x64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH" 1>&2; exit 1 ;; esac; ln -sf "${workspaceFolder}/publish/$RID/GTToolsSharp" "$HOME/.local/bin/gttoolssharp"
